taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-11, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 82.6 | 5.04 | 5.04
2 | 162.4 | 1.62 | 6.66
3 | 121.3 | 2.57 | 9.23
4 | 152.0 | 0.91 | 10.14
5 | 105.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-11, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-11, Survey Area T**

The interpreted 5-layer resistivity model shows the following sequence with depth: Layer 1 (82.6 Ω·m, 0–5.04 m), Layer 2 (162.4 Ω·m, 5.04–6.66 m), Layer 3 (121.3 Ω·m, 6.66–9.23 m), Layer 4 (152.0 Ω·m, 9.23–10.14 m), and Layer 5 (105.9 Ω·m, basement, no lower bound).

Applying the three-layer curve-type rule to each successive triplet:
- Layers 1-2-3: 82.6 < 162.4 > 121.3 → K
- Layers 2-3-4: 162.4 > 121.3 < 152.0 → H
- Layers 3-4-5: 121.3 < 152.0 > 105.9 → K

This gives a derived curve type of **KHK**, not the **QHK** recorded in the file. The first segment requires a rise in resistivity (Layer 1 < Layer 2), which is inconsistent with a Q-type (monotonically decreasing) start. The on-file label should be corrected to KHK.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
